NEAR TESTNET. HACKATHON BUILD. BOTH CONTRACTS ARE LIVE ON TESTNET, AND THE WHOLE STORY HAS RUN THERE: A TIP TRIAGED, RESOLVED BY THE DAO AND PAID, AND A FIRED SWITCH RELEASED BY THE KEEPER.

A TIP LINE WHOSE SERVERS CANNOT READ YOUR FILES

Evidence is cleaned inside your browser, encrypted before it leaves, and stored as ciphertext. The server that receives it keeps no logs, sets no cookies, and loads nothing that is not part of this build. A reward is held in escrow on-chain before anyone reads what you sent.

Submit a tip
What gives a document away
WHAT GIVES A DOCUMENT AWAY

Leaked files carry identifying detail their authors never meant to publish. This is what the cleaner in this build does with each of it. Nothing here is a promise about formats we do not handle.

PDF metadata and revision history

Each page is rasterised to pixels at 150 dpi and re-encoded as JPEG at quality 0.85, then rebuilt as a new document. The text layer, the embedded fonts, the producer string, and the creation and modification timestamps do not survive, because there is nothing left to carry them.

Rasterising is the only step that removes the things a PDF can hide: invisible text layers, attached files, and the XMP packet that records who saved it last.

Skip to main content
SEALED TIP
Menu
FUND A PROGRAMME

Set the scope and the bounty cap, lock the reward escrow, and hand adjudication to a panel of accounts you choose.

Contract sealedtip.st-hack-f8d075.testnet

What happens to the money
Nothing is locked when a tip arrives
A submission reserves no reward funds, so a junk tip cannot freeze the pool. What it costs the tipster is CPU: the proof-of-work puzzle.
A reserve is taken at triage
When an appointed panel member marks a tip credible, exactly max_reward is reserved from the programme balance. No earlier.
Unreserved funds stay yours
balance − reserved can be moved at any time with withdraw_unreserved, including while another tip is under review.
A dismissal returns the reserve
Dismissed or rejected: the whole reserve comes back in that call. Accepted below max_reward: the unused part comes back then, and the reward part is freed when the tipster claims.
